title: Prospecting
summary: Build a small verified prospect list and apply one separately approved update to a matching contact in HubSpot.
outcome: A bounded list of provider-backed prospects with explicit fit reasons and, when a unique existing CRM match exists, one human-approved HubSpot property update.
boundary: The candidate does not create contacts, send outreach, expand a list without approval, treat uncertain emails as deliverable or mutate HubSpot without an exact diff approval.

catalog_tools.purpose: Find an address only when the human supplied a named person.
Find a unique existing CRM contact by verified email.
Apply the exact human-approved property diff.
Add labelled recent public context without replacing structured identity evidence.

inputs: One supplied company domain or a narrow profile that yields an approved domain
Existing HubSpot property and intended value
outputs: Accepted and rejected prospects with provider evidence and fit reasons
Email verification status for the selected contact
Optional approved update to one unique existing HubSpot contact

cost.model: Inspected per-call prices across discovery, enrichment, verification and optional connected-app operations.
cost.notes: Draft trial mode is one company and one contact; it cannot publish until current supplier and full-route rehearsal gates pass.

approvals: Approve exact paid inputs and maximum before research
Approve any expansion beyond one company and one contact
Approve the exact HubSpot contact and property diff before the write
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with the five public control tools
A human-connected HubSpot account for the optional CRM step
